rdfs:label: height
rdfs:comment: On an ActivityStreams Link, a hint for the rendering height, in device-independent (CSS) pixels, of the linked resource. Widely also used on Image, Video and Document attachments in ActivityPub.
notes: Device-independent pixels (a rendering hint, not necessarily the intrinsic pixel size). Pair with `as:width` so renderers can reserve layout space and avoid reflow when the image loads. For multi-resolution variants, expose each as a distinct Link with its own height/width and let clients pick.

history.note: Comment reflects upstream Link domain and rendering-hint semantics; notes say device-independent pixels; removed width from notToBeConfusedWith.
